hero.headline: Outcomes, not billable hours
hero.subhead: My priority isn't stacking hours of code, but understanding your company's operational bottleneck to map a precise solution: we optimize your current resources, remove the bottleneck, and give your team back productive time.

about.title: About {{brand}}
about.body: I'm {{brand}}, a Software Developer and Architect focused on delivering operational predictability through technology. I help SMBs and forward-thinking clients unclog their processes and remove bottlenecks, following one simple rule: Plan and Act. First I define clear, achievable specifications — no fantasy goals — then I execute efficiently, pairing solid engineering fundamentals with AI-agent-driven development. The result: a scalable structure that returns your focus to the business, not the operations.

about.title: About
about.body: I'm {{brand}} — a technical strategist focused on the intersection of robust engineering and editorial design.

methodology.title: How I Work
methodology.subtitle: Understand, Plan, Act — in that order.

understand.title: Understand
understand.body: Beyond the symptom and its immediate cause: I dig into the why behind the business and where the pain actually started. I absorb your company's context before forming any opinion worth acting on.

plan.title: Plan
plan.body: Planning isn't just moving technical pieces — subscriptions, stacks, approaches. It's mapping how that technical approach lands on the people who'll actually use it day to day.

act.title: Act
act.body: Execution isn't a speed contest. I move as fast as the project's real urgency and complexity allow — not faster, not slower.

contact.title: Let's Talk
contact.subtitle: Tell me about the bottleneck — I'll respond within 48 hours with real questions, not a sales pitch.
